A Letter From A Reader With An Important Lesson

Mr. Cowan,

In response to your requests for Marijuana related incidents I’d like to share with you an experience which happened to me about 4 years ago.

After leaving college I had a collection of paraphernalia from Bongs to Hookahs, to original water pipes to typical Cancun marble pipes (22 to be exact). For some time I stored these in my second car which I did not drive. I had to sell that car for lack of storage space and so was forced to put the contents into my Acura's trunk not for use but for storage.

On the night in question I had picked up my then girlfriend, now my wife, to go out to a friend’s home. Upon arriving at my friend’s apartment complex I parked my car and in the time it took to turn off the car and get my girlfriend's purse from the back seat, I noticed a search light from a private security officers car.

As I opened my door to step out, I was blinded by the search light and heard a voice say, "Don't step out of the car driver!" then saying "Is that a pipe I see in your door?" Startled I paused and answered, "where"? By the time I had answered, a second officer's car had pulled up and the original officer was at my car looking with a flashlight at the interior of my car and my girlfriend. I was asked to step out of the car and if I had any pipes or marijuana in the car. I said I may have a pipe, then was questioned if I would allow a search. Stupidly assuming this was all Bullshit, I said yes.

(Marijuananews note: Never ever consent to a search! Don’t resist, but never consent!)

At which point I was placed in custody and my girlfriend was removed from the car and told to sit on the curb. By this time 4 or 5 security guard cars had arrived as well as at least three County Police cars. You would have thought they busted the Gambinos with all the blue and red lights which were present. My entire car was searched and they recovered 22 articles of paraphernalia as well as two packets of empty rolling papers (trash) and some screens (all basically useless without any resin).

I was arrested for possession of paraphernalia 22+ accounts and was driven to the County Jail (holding tank) until my release later that night. My girlfriend was almost left at the scene but due to the distance she lived from the location they took her to the station where she had to all for a friend to pick her up. Through a bargain process I took community service for the charge and had my records expunged, which was very lucky in comparison to others I know who have had the same fate.

Has my view of the law changed as a result of this intrusion? NO! Of course not! Now I have less respect for private security and the police than I ever did.

Had I had my ACLU "bust-pass" instructing me on what to do in the event of a search request I wouldn't have complied and would still have my 3.5 foot Hookah!

To those who might read my story as a case of "stoner gets the bum rush" its much more than that. I did nothing to draw attention to myself other than park my car and get out.

Maybe it was the wrong place at the wrong time but what suspicion other than a minority male driving an Acura would make me a suspect?

As an adult I should have my rights protected and not disrespected to fight a War which I don't ever recall  American Citizens waging...

Thanks for the soapbox to stand upon..
